gloss: skin of the hands; hand skin

definitions.gloss: skin of the hands; hand skin
definitions.explanation: The skin on one's hands, especially when discussing its condition, care, or appearance. Frequently used in advertising and product descriptions for hand creams, dishwashing liquids, and skincare items.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{手肌|てはだ}が{荒|あ}れやすい。
examples.english: In winter, the skin on your hands tends to get rough.

examples.japanese: {手肌|てはだ}に{優|やさ}しい{洗剤|せんざい}を{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: I use a detergent that is gentle on the hands.

examples.japanese: {水仕事|みずしごと}が{多|おお}いので、{手肌|てはだ}の{乾燥|かんそう}を{防|ふせ}ぐためにハンドクリームを{欠|か}かさず{塗|ぬ}るようにしている。
examples.english: Because I do a lot of work involving water, I make sure to always apply hand cream to prevent my hand skin from drying out.

notes:
Composed of {手|て} (hand) and {肌|はだ} (skin). A practical compound frequently seen in advertising for skincare products, hand creams, and household cleaners. The word highlights the skin's condition — roughness, dryness, softness — rather than the hand itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手肌|てはだ}に{優|やさ}しい: gentle on the hands
- {手肌|てはだ}が{荒|あ}れる: the skin on one's hands becomes rough
- {手肌|てはだ}の{乾燥|かんそう}: dryness of the hand skin
- {手肌|てはだ}を{守|まも}る: to protect one's hand skin
- {手肌|てはだ}{用|よう}: for hand skin care

RELATED TERMS:
- {肌荒|はだあ}れ: rough skin; skin irritation — broader term for any skin roughness
- {素肌|すはだ}: bare skin — skin without makeup or covering
- ハンドクリーム: hand cream — the product most associated with {手肌|てはだ} care
